about: Who the countryside's people and animals are and what they do: every painted figure and animal of S1 (map/text/S1.md, u 29050-37610) at its mapped spot (layout.json), and nobody else (map/BUILDING.md). Written by gen/sections/countryside/make_people.py (the casting of gen/expand/countryside_needs.md and the lead's calls of 2026-10-12: everyone from the 22 existing characters); rerun it when the workshop delivers characters, clips and props, or when the builder rebuilds (its raw GLB's colliders, ground_at.json, placed.json). figures: character (the catalogue's target; a pose fallback where neither the target nor the interim can hold the pose yet: cast_why), stand_in (the interim cast until the target is built), do = [clip, seconds] cycles with clips the playing character has (clips_why: what is still to make), nudge = [dX, dD] (nudge_why), scale for children (scale_why), ride = the animal a rider sits on, props = carried prop_<name> parts (props_why). walkers: the charcoal train's drivers, the travellers on foot and the runaway horse's grooms, walking along their painted direction and back (walkers_why). animals: each painted animal at its map position facing hind to fore, model and load from web/public/assets/animals/animals.json; path = it walks (the charcoal train, the travellers' donkeys, the runaway horse). No traffic.
